blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bicol Saro party-list Rep. Terry Ridon has asked whether Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband Manases Carpio considers himself an oligarch, as the reason that he gave for huge sports apparel purchases—supporting basketball teams—is often reserved for big business players. Ridon, in an interview on the sidelines of Duterte’s impeachment trial, maintained that the reasons given by Carpio do not suffice as explanations for the huge credit card expenses he supposedly made in 2025. Part of the testimony from prosecution witness and financial forensic analyst Atty. Alexander Cabrera regarding Duterte’s unexplained wealth was “unusual banking behavior” that included two […]...
